claims.statement: On the six Boolean challenge-by-mode cells, if an unobserved downstream writer has timely access to challenge and mode, command/actuator/endpoint replay does not identify the named target writer: a target-idle observational twin exists.
claims.domain: q in {0,1}; mode in {baseline,block,rescue}; deterministic downstream plant/readout; monitor lacks independently complete writer provenance.
all_premises: hidden writer may read q and mode before actuation
hidden writer may overwrite the selected actuator value downstream of the target
writer identity is not independently observed
downstream transition and endpoint are deterministic functions of the final actuator value
claims.proof_or_source: Construct H(q,mode)=G(q,mode); exhaustive enumeration of 64 tables finds one exact twin.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: A trusted complete writer inventory plus a cut or challenge-isolation premise removes this exact construction; the result is not universal over every instrumented device.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Copy/switch and hidden-magnet/calculator witness: identical transitions can conceal writer substitution.

claims.statement: No hidden writer whose output depends only on mode can reproduce G(q,mode)=q,0,q across both challenge values; testing q=1 alone leaves one exact twin.
claims.domain: The same six cells and the eight mode-only Boolean tables.
all_premises: every non-target writer is physically fixed across paired challenges
non-target writers cannot access q or a timely correlate
target/rescue interface is the only admitted timely q channel
post-arbitration probe and cut/rescue locality are faithful
claims.proof_or_source: Baseline and rescue each require one fixed h(mode) to equal both 0 and 1; exact enumeration confirms zero six-cell matches and one q=1-only match.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: If any hidden writer sees q, A4D-N1 applies. The physical premises are not proved by the enumeration.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Ancestor/formation and human-realized-agent controls vary hidden timely access while fixing outputs.

claims.statement: The eight-clause AWC package is sufficient only for device-relative evidence that the named target route carries paired challenge dependence to the selected actuator transition.
claims.domain: One frozen physical device bearer, interval, declared device signature, writer set, target consumer/interface, arbitration and probe placement.
claims.proof_or_source: Contract synthesis from A4C-G2 and A4D-N1/P1; ordinary causal isolation logic, not a completed installation.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: Omit any clause and a hidden writer, direct rescue, misplaced probe or boundary redraw can mimic the result.
claims.thought_experiment_role: All four inherited families test boundary, route and writer substitutions.

claims.statement: A successful AWC installation would not by itself establish complete K, a C1 instance, RetBind, B_fam, H_way, report identity, conceptual self or an exclusive owner.
claims.domain: UCT application of any future AWC device result.
all_premises: C1 remains a stipulated tokenwise consciousness-specific axiom
